name: Diarbbitmon
main_effect:
＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.)
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] Suspend 1 of your opponent’s Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no unsuspended Digimon in play, gain 1 memory.
[End of Your Turn] 1 of your Digimon with [Angoramon] in its text may attack an opponent's Digimon.
